log_to_file: create a function that incrementally appends key-value fields as rows to a TSV log file in the current directory
symlink_path: create a symlink pointing to a target path, removing any existing symlink at the destination if present
write_metadata: write a JSON metadata file capturing environment variables, start time, and git repo info for a given directory
review_log_to_file: review the log_to_file function that uses a mutable default dict to persist a CSV writer across calls
refactor_write_metadata: refactor write_metadata to support additional metadata fields beyond environment variables and git commit data
